name: Qidian Shidai
source:
Despite being a talented tech worker at Thunder Corporation, a sudden, unfair dismissal throws your life into chaos. Determined to clear your name and pursue your dream of a decentralized cloud server, you assemble a team of brilliant individuals: your genius little sister, a soulful singer, a charming HR manager, and a young CEO. As you undertake this new path, you'll face both professional and personal challenges. Will you be able to prove your innocence, revolutionize the industry, and find love along the way?
